name: A Dark Threat Looms
summary: Dark Iron explosives threaten the Stonewrought Dam, and Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII needs your help. He asks you to gather rare reagents from Loch Modan so he can make a mixture to neutralize them.

sections.title: A Volatile Recipe
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII needs three ingredients for his mixture. Forest Lurker venom, a tear from a crocolisk in the Loch, and a Mo'grosh crystal each bring a different reaction. Together, they can render the dwarven charges inert.

sections.title: Perilous Gathering
sections.body: The ingredients lie in dangerous parts of Loch Modan. Forest Lurker spiders and crocolisks threaten travelers, while Mo'grosh ogres guard their mined crystals in a stronghold to the northeast. Reaching the crystals means facing the ogres in their encampments.

faq.q: Why does Engineer Hinderweir need these specific reagents?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII needs the reagents to make a compound that can defuse Dark Iron explosives. Lurker venom, crocolisk secretions, and Mo'grosh crystals provide the reactions needed to render the saboteurs' charges inert.

faq.q: Where do Mo'grosh crystals come from?
faq.answer: Mo'grosh ogres mine and hoard the crystals in the northeastern hills of Loch Modan. Reaching one means entering their heavily defended territory.

faq.q: What is the dark threat menacing Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarf infiltrators seek to destroy the Stonewrought Dam. Its destruction would flood the Wetlands below, cut Alliance supply lines, and devastate the region.

faq.q: Who is Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII is the dwarven engineer who oversees the Stonewrought Dam's operations and integrity. He directs its maintenance and local defenses against sabotage.

faq.q: Where can the indigenous creatures be found?
faq.answer: Forest Lurker spiders roam the wooded wilderness around the valley. Crocolisks live in and around the Loch's shores.

faq.q: Why don't the Ironforge guards gather these items themselves?
faq.answer: Mountaineers and local guards are stretched thin defending towns like Thelsamar and watching for Dark Iron scouts. Specialized searches and forays into ogre territory fall to capable travelers.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can appreciate Hinderweir's ingenuity in making a chemical counter-agent to stabilize volatile demolition charges in the field.
As a dwarf of Khaz Modan, you have a vital duty to stop Dark Iron sabotage at the Stonewrought Dam and protect your ancestral lands and their great works.
As an Alliance traveler, you know the dam's destruction would sever critical overland supply routes between Ironforge and the northern kingdoms.
